code: import axios from"axios";const AUTH_API="http://localhost:9000/auth";export const registerUser=data=>{return axios.post("".concat(AUTH_API,"/register"),data);};export const loginUser=async data=>{const res=await axios.post("".concat(AUTH_API,"/login"),data);localStorage.setItem("token",res.data);return res;};export const logout=()=>{localStorage.removeItem("token");};
